english: the welfare of the people is the supreme law

evidence: Cic. Leg. 3.8: ollīs salūs populī suprēma lēx estō
terms.comment: From the laws Cicero drafts for his ideal state, of the consuls: “for them the safety of the people shall be the highest law” (ollīs is old Latin for illīs).

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, cited by printed page; each phrase checked against the searchable text of the book.
Cicero, De legibus 3.8, checked against the Latin Library texts (CLTK mirror) (12 November 2026).
